gitCommit.subject: fix(canvas): allow Ctrl/Cmd multi-select for objects inside frames (#1432)
gitCommit.body:
fix(canvas): allow Ctrl/Cmd multi-select for objects inside frames (#1432)

* fix(canvas): allow Ctrl/Cmd multi-select for objects inside frames

Frame children onClick handlers were missing the isCtrlOrCmd guard that
non-frame objects already have. When Ctrl/Cmd+clicking a frame child,
Stage onMouseDown correctly added it to multi-selection, but the child
onClick then called selectImage/selectText/etc without isMultiSelect,
overwriting the selection back to single-select.

Add isCtrlOrCmd early-return to handleChildClick (image, video),
TextV2, Shape, Tone inline onClick, and frame background onClick,
matching the pattern used by gazai-canvas.tsx for non-frame objects.

* fix(canvas): transparent frame background during drawing

Frame background is now transparent while the user drags to create it,
so they can see the objects underneath being framed. Once mouseUp
commits the frame, fillColor is cleared and the default white fill
takes effect.
